constituentArticles.title: FDI Flow in Banking Sector Declined to $115 Million in FY25
constituentArticles.text: MoS Finance Pankaj Chaudhary stated banking FDI fell to $115M in FY25. SBI highest foreign holding among PSBs at 11.07%, followed by Canara 10.55%.
